game_cases.title: Detective Academy: Missing Evidence
game_cases.description: Welcome to the Project Vritra Investigation Division. As a new recruit, you must complete training by solving a missing evidence case. Learn the basics of SQL investigation through this introductory mission.
game_cases.story_background: You have just joined the Investigation Division under Prasoon Pathak. Before you can work on real cases, you must prove your SQL skills by solving a training mystery involving missing evidence from the evidence locker.

game_cases.title: The Nagabhavan Estate Mystery
game_cases.description: Industrialist Rajveer Rathore is found dead inside his locked study at Nagabhavan Estate. What initially appears to be suicide soon reveals signs of murder.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon Pathak is called to Nagabhavan Estate after ACP Rudransh Pathak suspects foul play in a seemingly impossible locked-room death.

game_cases.title: The Poisoned Soma
game_cases.description: Scholar and Ayurvedic researcher Acharya Devendra Mishra collapses during a private symposium after consuming a ceremonial Soma preparation.
game_cases.story_background: Ancient mythology appears connected to a modern murder.

game_cases.title: The Temple Cipher
game_cases.description: A temple archivist is murdered after uncovering an encrypted Sanskrit message hidden within ancient records.
game_cases.story_background: The investigation leads Prasoon Pathak and his team into centuries-old secrets connected to the Ninth Mandala.

game_cases.title: The Silent Devotee
game_cases.description: A monk who had not spoken for eight years is found murdered at Rudra Peeth Monastery. Before his death, he leaves behind a cryptic message linked to the serpent symbol.
game_cases.story_background: The investigation uncovers a hidden connection between ancient manuscripts and a modern conspiracy.

game_cases.title: The Ashes of Dharma
game_cases.description: Politician Devendra Pratap Singh dies in a suspicious fire hours before exposing a powerful organization known as Project Vritra.
game_cases.story_background: The investigation reveals the first modern conspiracy linked directly to Project Vritra.

game_cases.title: The Twin Illusion
game_cases.description: A man officially declared dead five years ago suddenly appears in financial records under a different identity.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon investigates how a dead man returned to life.

game_cases.title: The Wheel of Time
game_cases.description: A government analyst is murdered after discovering impossible discrepancies in national event records.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon uncovers evidence suggesting someone is manipulating historical timelines.

game_cases.title: The Forgotten Monk
game_cases.description: A monk with no official identity appears in classified Project Vritra records. Investigating his past uncovers decades of memory manipulation experiments.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon discovers evidence of psychological experiments linked to Project Vritra.

game_cases.title: The Serpent Ledger
game_cases.description: An accountant linked to multiple shell organizations is murdered after discovering a hidden financial network funding Project Vritra.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon follows a financial trail connecting every previous case.

game_cases.title: The Vanishing Disciple
game_cases.description: A key witness connected to the Inner Circle disappears and all official records begin vanishing with him.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon discovers that Project Vritra can erase people from existence.

game_cases.title: The Seven Shadows
game_cases.description: A retired intelligence officer is murdered after attempting to expose the secret leadership behind Project Vritra.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon discovers the hidden architects behind decades of manipulation.

game_cases.title: The Maya Protocol
game_cases.description: A forensic analyst is murdered after discovering a classified system capable of manufacturing evidence and manipulating reality itself.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon discovers that Project Vritra can create false truths.

game_cases.title: The Crimson Yagna
game_cases.description: A sociologist is murdered after discovering that decades of disasters, murders and political crises were intentionally engineered as part of a social experiment.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon uncovers the true purpose behind Project Vritra.

game_cases.title: The Oracle Network
game_cases.description: A senior Oracle architect is murdered after attempting to expose the predictive system controlling Project Vritra.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon uncovers the true purpose and scale of the Oracle Network.

game_cases.title: The Hidden Manuscript
game_cases.description: A historian is murdered while decoding a manuscript that predates Project Vritra and reveals the origins of its ideology.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon discovers the true philosophical origin of Project Vritra.

game_cases.title: The Vritra Cycle
game_cases.description: A former Ninth Mandala archivist is murdered after revealing a master archive connecting every Project Vritra operation.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon uncovers the complete architecture behind Project Vritra.

game_cases.title: The Ninth Realm
game_cases.description: Prasoon infiltrates the hidden command structure of the Ninth Mandala and discovers evidence of a systematic internal collapse.
game_cases.story_background: The final operational center of Project Vritra is uncovered.

game_cases.title: The Last Witness
game_cases.description: The final surviving founder of Project Vritra is murdered before testifying. His testimony reveals the true purpose behind the entire conspiracy.
game_cases.story_background: Prasoon confronts the architect of Project Vritra.

game_objectives.title: View All Evidence
game_objectives.description: Use SELECT to retrieve all items from the evidence_locker table. This will show you everything in the evidence locker.
game_objectives.hint: The SELECT statement retrieves data from a table. Use: SELECT * FROM table_name

game_objectives.title: Find Missing Evidence
game_objectives.description: Use WHERE to filter for items with status "Missing". We need to identify what evidence has disappeared.
game_objectives.hint: The WHERE clause filters results. Use: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE column = 'value'

game_objectives.title: Count Evidence by Type
game_objectives.description: Use COUNT with GROUP BY to count how many items of each type are in the evidence locker.
game_objectives.expected_query: SELECT item_type, COUNT(*) FROM evidence_locker GROUP BY item_type
game_objectives.hint: COUNT() with GROUP BY aggregates data. Use: SELECT column, COUNT(*) FROM table_name GROUP BY column

game_objectives.title: View Recent Evidence
game_objectives.description: Use LIMIT to show only the first 5 items in the evidence locker. This helps you focus on the most recent entries.
game_objectives.hint: LIMIT restricts the number of rows returned. Use: SELECT * FROM table_name LIMIT number

game_objectives.title: Sort Evidence by Date
game_objectives.description: Use ORDER BY to sort evidence by date_added in descending order (newest first). This helps track when items were added.
game_objectives.expected_query: SELECT * FROM evidence_locker ORDER BY date_added DESC
game_objectives.hint: ORDER BY sorts results. Use DESC for descending order: SELECT * FROM table_name ORDER BY column DESC

game_objectives.title: Find Missing Physical Evidence
game_objectives.description: Combine what you learned: Find all missing items of type "Physical". This is the critical evidence we need to recover.
game_objectives.expected_query: SELECT * FROM evidence_locker WHERE status = 'Missing' AND item_type = 'Physical'
game_objectives.hint: You can combine multiple conditions with AND: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE condition1 AND condition2
